question: What K2O and Fe2O3 contents did the corn straw fuel and the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel have?
rendered:
According to Table 2 in the document, the K2O content of corn straw fuel (SF) was not directly provided, but the content of the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel (CF) was 0.63 ± 0.01 wt %. 

The Fe2O3 content of corn straw fuel (SF) was 17.71 ± 0.22 wt %, and the Fe2O3 content of the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel (CF) was 4.67 ± 0.01 wt %.
